semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in precision probes and testing solutions for semiconductor applications.
summary: Shenzhen Merry Precise Electronic Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells precision probes used in semiconductor testing, including ICT and FCT probes. With over 20 years of experience, the company has developed advanced micro-scale probe technologies and maintains a strong focus on R&D to enhance testing capabilities in the electronics industry.

regional_presence.Asia: The company has a service network covering the Asian market.
